prompt: Phenol (PhOH, pKa ~10) is much more acidic than cyclohexanol (pKa ~17). Why?

options.label: The phenoxide anion is resonance-stabilized — the negative charge delocalizes over the ortho and para positions of the ring.
Phenol has a smaller alpha carbon.
The O–H bond in phenol is weaker because O is attached to sp² C.

explanation: Deprotonation gives phenoxide, where the negative charge delocalizes into the ring (ortho and para). This resonance stabilization lowers phenol's pKa by about 7 units vs an aliphatic alcohol.
